Behavior-based conversion CTAs triggered by visitor scroll depth.

== Description ==

Scroll Magnet helps WordPress site owners display calls to action when visitors are truly engaged with the page.

Instead of using intrusive popups at random moments, Scroll Magnet triggers targeted conversion messages based on scroll depth.

Typical use cases:

- 50% scroll: highlight an offer
- 70% scroll: show a floating button
- 90% scroll: display a final soft popup

This makes the plugin useful for:

- lead generation
- promo offers
- product discovery
- conversion recovery near the end of an article or sales page

== Features ==

- 3 configurable scroll triggers
- 3 display formats: bottom banner, floating button, popup
- Custom message, button label and URL
- Simple targeting rules
- Device and URL-based targeting
- Lightweight front-end loading
- Basic view and click tracking
- Live preview in the admin page
- CSV export and stats reset
- Recent activity log
- Visual templates
- Top pages analytics

== Installation ==

1. Upload the plugin folder to `/wp-content/plugins/`.
2. Activate `Scroll Magnet` through the WordPress plugins screen.
3. Go to `Settings > Scroll Magnet`.
4. Configure your scroll triggers and save changes.

== Screenshots ==

1. Scroll Magnet settings screen with trigger configuration, live preview and stats.

== Frequently Asked Questions ==

= Can I use it only on posts? =

Yes. The plugin includes simple targeting for posts only, pages only, all singular content, or specific page IDs.

= Is this a popup plugin? =

It can show a popup, but its main value is behavior-based conversion triggering based on engagement.

= Does it include analytics? =

This version includes simple per-trigger view and click counters. More advanced analytics and testing are planned for a future premium version.
